title: Book One · Chapter 164: Mum Finishes Early
story:
Mum finishes the paid repairs on Tuesday afternoon. Each piece of work has a small note. She reads the note and checks her work. The shirts have their buttons. The child's coat has a new edge inside one sleeve. The blue skirt hangs evenly from its folded waist.

Ronan helps put clean paper between the clothes. He reads the names aloud while Mum checks them. These are not display labels. Each name tells her the owner of that shirt, coat, or skirt.

One woman arrives before supper. She tries on the shirt. She lifts both arms and looks at the cuffs. “How do the cuffs feel?” Mum asks. The woman bends her wrist. One cuff catches against it. She points to the tight part on her wrist.

Mum looks at the cuff and marks the place. She asks for ten minutes to change it. The shirt looks neat, but the cuff catches. Mum listens to the woman's words. Ronan moves the clean paper for the shirt away. Mum needs to open the stitches in the cuff.

The second try is better. The woman pays and leaves with the shirt. Mum writes the payment in her small book, then shuts it with a long breath.

“Now the school bag?” Ronan asks.

“Now my tea.”

He runs to get the cup. Dad is home early and makes the tea. Soon all three are sitting outside for a while. There is still light in the yard. Mr Qiu has closed the table. Mrs Lan waters the pot and tells the black cat not to sleep in it.

Ronan tells Mum he is glad she finished in time for Saturday. She looks at the work bag beside her feet.

“So am I. But this work had its own date. I did not finish it only to come to school.”

He nods. He thought Mum finished early just for his display. But the woman needs her shirt on Thursday. Her cuffs must fit well. That matters to Mum too.

After tea Mum brings out the blue display bag. She wipes the handles with a dry cloth. Then she puts the three light books inside. Mum puts her own card in a paper cover. The little try-it sign goes with it. She checks the name and the stitched mark.

“Will you explain it?” Ronan asks.

“For part of the time. Then I want to look at Mei's pictures and play Leo's game.”

“And the stool?”

“I sit on it every day. I may give someone else a turn.”

Dad laughs. He checks the stool once more while Mum reads the carrying plan. Leo's mother will meet her at half past one. Pictures go on Friday. The bag comes with Mum. Ronan takes the light school papers. Mr Qiu brings the empty pencil box and pad.

There are no new jobs to add tonight. Mum puts the bag safely inside and comes back without her needle. “Would you like to see a new ball trick?” Ronan asks. She says yes, after he moves the tea cups.

He moves them. The first trick fails. The ball rolls under Dad's chair. Ronan looks at the ball under the chair. Mum laughs and asks for a turn. She tries the same throw herself. Her throw is not better. For ten minutes they just play with the ball. Mum has no needle in her hand. Dad does not check the stool again.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：wrist＝手腕；payment＝报酬；a turn＝一次轮到自己的机会。

情节提示：cuff＝袖口；waist＝腰部；stitched mark＝缝出的标记。

理解：1. 客人提出袖口不合适时 Mum 怎样处理？2. 她希望在河街日怎样使用自己的时间？
